devdoc.details: Proxy contract for interacting with the Pool contract. This contract handles supply, withdraw, borrow, and repay operations.

OwnableInvalidOwner(address).details: The owner is not a valid owner account. (eg. `address(0)`)

OwnableUnauthorizedAccount(address).details: The caller account is not authorized to perform an operation.

Initialized(uint64).details: Triggered when the contract has been initialized or reinitialized.

borrow(bytes,bytes).details: External function to handle the borrow operation via cross-chain layer.

params.tacHeader: The TAC header for cross-chain communication.

constructor.details: Constructor to initialize the contract with the application and settings addresses.

params.appAddress: The address of the application contract.
params.settingsAddress: The address of the settings contract.

owner().details: Returns the address of the current owner.

renounceOwnership().details: Leaves the contract without owner. It will not be possible to call `onlyOwner` functions. Can only be called by the current owner. NOTE: Renouncing ownership will leave the contract without an owner, thereby disabling any functionality that is only available to the owner.

repay(bytes,bytes).details: External function to handle the repay operation via cross-chain layer.

params.tacHeader: The TAC header for cross-chain communication.

supply(bytes,bytes).details: External function to handle the supply operation via cross-chain layer.

params.tacHeader: The TAC header for cross-chain communication.

transferOwnership(address).details: Transfers ownership of the contract to a new account (`newOwner`). Can only be called by the current owner.

withdraw(bytes,bytes).details: External function to handle the withdraw operation via cross-chain layer.

params.tacHeader: The TAC header for cross-chain communication.
